title: Get the Show on the Road!
overview: Pikachu is suffering from a serious electrical overload! Can Ash and Professor Birch find a solution before it's too late?

title: A Ruin with a View
overview: A power failure at the Pokémon Center leads Ash and his new friend May to an astonishing discovery!

title: There's No Place Like Hoenn
overview: Ash is ready for his first Gym battle in the Hoenn region--and the Gym Leader he must face is none other than May's father!

title: You Never Can Taillow!
overview: When Team Rocket turns a flock of Taillow against our heroes, an old friend comes to the rescue!

title: In the Knicker of Time!
overview: Ash and friends meet an eccentric Trainer who challenges May to her very first Pokémon battle!

title: A Poached Ego!
overview: Our heroes are on the trail of a Pokémon poacher, and Team Rocket is close behind!

title: Tree's a Crowd
overview: When Ash gets lost in the woods, he meets a Treecko who's determined to save its forest home.

title: A Tail with a Twist
overview: Ash's Treecko takes on a wild Seviper, but things don't go so well...

title: Taming of the Shroomish
overview: Stopping in Rinshin Town, our heroes investigate the mystery of a haunted mansion!

title: You Said a Mouthful!
overview: Ash can't resist challenging a Trainer who claims to have the world's most powerful Pokémon, but there's something odd about this battle...

title: A Bite to Remember
overview: After meeting a group of Mightyena, Max befriends a Poochyena who hasn't evolved yet and decides to train it himself!

title: The Lotad Lowdown
overview: Our heroes meet three sisters who grow berries with the help of a nearby group of Lotad!

title: All Things Bright and Beautifly!
overview: Ash and friends discover a whole new kind of Pokémon competition, and it seems May has found her calling!

title: All in a Day's Wurmple
overview: As May sets out to catch a Wurmple for her first Pokémon Contest, Ash receives a Double Battle challenge!

title: Gonna Rule the School!
overview: Our heroes check out the Pokémon Trainer's School in Rustboro City, where Max has a run-in with a classmate!

title: The Winner by a Nosepass!
overview: Armed with Pikachu's new Iron Tail attack, Ash challenges Gym Leader Roxanne!

title: Stairway to Devon
overview: As our heroes tour the massive Devon Corporation, a mysterious intruder tries to steal an important piece of equipment!

title: On a Wingull and a Prayer!
overview: Mr. Briney the sailor offers to take our heroes to Dewford Island for Ash's next Gym battle, but then changes his mind. What's going on?

title: Sharpedo Attack!
overview: When a school of Sharpedo attacks, Ash and friends are stranded on an uncharted island!

title: Brave the Wave
overview: Ash challenges the Dewford Gym, but Gym Leader Brawly seems more interested in surfing!ets the Gym Leader Brawly, who would rather surf than battle, which infuriates Ash. Could there be more to this Gym Leader than meets the eye? And does May even have a shred of decency?

title: Which Wurmple's Which?
overview: May and Jessie of Team Rocket both have a Wurmple, and the two Pokémon accidentally get swapped during a battle!

title: A Hole Lotta Trouble
overview: Ash and friends meet Steven Stone in Granite Cave, where they quickly fall into one of Team Rocket's traps!

title: Gone Corphishin'
overview: A mysterious Pokémon keeps burrowing through the beach near our heroes' camp and knocking over everything in its way!

title: A Corphish Out of Water
overview: When Ash's rowdy new Corphish eats something it shouldn't, he goes on a dangerous journey to get it to the Pokémon Center!

title: A Mudkip Mission
overview: Ash and friends come across a lake full of Mudkip and soon find themselves protecting the Pokémon from a Team Rocket scheme!

title: Turning Over a Nuzleaf
overview: When our heroes get separated from their Pokémon in a deep, dark cave, both groups find themselves in trouble!

title: A Three Team Scheme!
overview: Ash and the others meet up with Professor Birch for a day of exploration and end up in the middle of a villainous confrontation!

title: Seeing Is Believing!
overview: Jessie of Team Rocket is sure her Pokémon will evolve into a lovely Beautifly someday, but she could be in for a rude awakening!

title: Ready, Willing, and Sableye
overview: Deciding it's time to teach his unruly Corphish a lesson, Ash leads the Pokémon into an abandoned mine, where things are not as they seem...

title: A Meditite Fight!
overview: The approach of a dangerous storm calls a halt to Ash's latest battle challenge!

title: Just One of the Geysers
overview: In a secret island arena with an unusual battlefield, Dewford Gym Leader Brawly welcomes Ash for a rematch!

title: Abandon Ship!
overview: Our heroes find themselves aboard an abandoned ship...and then start disappearing one by one!

title: Now That's Flower Power!
overview: While May trains for the Pokémon Contest in Slateport City, Torchic's appetite for berries gets her in trouble!

title: Having a Wailord of a Time
overview: A new Trainer is stopping by a Pokémon Center to choose her first partner Pokémon, and Nurse Joy asks Ash and Max to take care of Treecko, Torchic, and Mudkip for her!

title: Win, Lose or Drew!
overview: It's time for May's first Pokémon Contest! Does her Beautifly have what it takes to win a ribbon?

title: The Spheal of Approval
overview: A day of relaxation in Slateport City turns into a confrontation between Team Rocket and Team Magma!

title: Jump for Joy!
overview: Ash and friends stop at a Pokémon Center for directions, but there's no sign of Nurse Joy! What could have happened to her?

title: A Different Kind of Misty!
overview: Ash and friends visit a lighthouse, where they try to return a stolen item they recovered from Team Rocket--but the lighthouse keepers think our heroes are the thieves!

title: A Poké-BLOCK Party
overview: Ash and friends join the Trick House Contest, which sends them through a maze full of tricks and traps--and, of course, Team Rocket!

title: Watt's with Wattson
overview: When Ash challenges the Mauville City Gym, he soon finds himself face to face with the Legendary Pokémon Raikou, or so it would seem...

title: What You Seed Is What You Get
overview: When Ash's Treecko and Corphish face Grovyle and Slugma in a double battle, Treecko turns the tables, learning to use Bullet Seed.

title: Love at First Flight
overview: Our heroes discover a love story between two Trainers who star with their Pokémon in a local dance festival.

title: Let Bagons Be Bagons
overview: A Trainer learns that Pokémon battling requires more than tactics and technology. Meanwhile, a Bagon dreams the impossible dream of taking flight.

title: The Princess and the Togepi (1)
overview: An invitation to the Togepi Festival brings Misty to the Hoenn region, where she learns that a local kingdom bases its rule on the whims of passing Togepi.

title: A Togepi Mirage! (2)
overview: Our heroes go up against an evil regent who would use Misty's Togepi to steal the throne from its rightful heir!

title: Candid Camerupt!
overview: Ash, Brock, May, and Max must all work together to face the four members of a family of skilled Pokémon Trainers and their powerful Pokémon.

title: I Feel Skitty!
overview: After her Skitty is exhausted by chasing its own tale, May entrusts it to a local aromatherapy house, where it recovers completely.

title: ZigZag Zangoose!
overview: A young trainer gains confidence and strengthens his bond with his Zangoose, when he is forced to face Seviper in a less than fair battle.

title: Maxxed Out!
overview: Max meets another young boy who shares his name, but differs greatly in personality. When this young and inexperienced new acquaintance goes off on his own, Ash and friends must track him down.

title: Pros and Con Artists (1)
overview: As May prepares for her first contest, Ash faces another contestant in a pre-contest battle.

title: Come What May! (2)
overview: May wins her first contest, finally earning a ribbon. Jessie of Team Rocket attempts to win by cheating, but is disqualified.

title: Cheer Pressure
overview: Ash and friends meet an old friend who has since joined a Pokémon cheering squad. When they expose his squad for a fake, the trainer is inspired to start anew.

title: Game Winning Assist
overview: When Team Rocket threatens an innocent family of ranchers, Ash and friends drive them away, with May's Eneko using Assist for the first time.

title: Fight for the Meteorite
overview: When Team Aqua and Team Magma battle to gain a meteor on Mount chimney, Ash and friends must put an end to both of their dastardly plans.

title: Poetry Commotion!
overview: No sooner has Ash begun an official battle with a novice gym leader, Flannery, than Team Rocket interrupts, postponing the battle for an extra day.

title: Going, Going, Yawn
overview: Ash is battling for his fourth Hoenn region Gym badge! Can his Corphish defeat Flannery's team of Fire types?

title: Going for a Spinda
overview: When rumors arise that a particular Spinda draws happiness to its trainer, Team Rocket quickly hatches a plan to steal this lucky Pokémon.

title: All Torkoal, No Play
overview: Ash and friends struggle to pass through a valley guarded by territorial Steel Pokémon.

title: Manectric Charge
overview: While Ash uses his Torkoal to battle the powerful Watson, May faces his assistant with her Skitty.

title: Delcatty Got Your Tongue
overview: When May's Skitty is injured far from a Pokémon Center, a master in the art of Pokémon massage comes to the rescue!

title: Disaster of Disguise
overview: When Ash and friends learn that a masked coordinator is attempting to compete in secret, they help the timid boy hide his identity.

title: Disguise Da Limit
overview: At Vendanturf Town, the masked trainer makes a strong performance, but loses to May's Skitty, as May wins her second ribbon.

title: Take the Lombre Home
overview: The people of a small village blame a local drought on the Pokémon Solrock, but it soon comes to light that the drought is in fact the work of Team Rocket.

title: True Blue Swablu
overview: May feels a special duty to help a wounded Swablu return to its flock.

title: Gulpin It Down!
overview: Mayhem ensues when Professor Oak inadvertently creates a gigantic Gulpin and Treecko in an effort to stop a Gulpin outbreak.

title: Exploud and Clear
overview: Even as Ash's Treecko evolves in the course of battle, his opponent's Loudred does the same. Team Rocket couldn't have picked a worse time to attack.

title: Go Go Ludicolo!
overview: Ash and friends must rely on Grovyle, Torkoal, and Corphish, as they approach Petalburg City.

title: A Double Dilemma
overview: When May and Max's father, Norman, reaches near celebrity status, Team Rocket pretends to be a part of the family.

title: Love, Petalburg Style!
overview: Rumors are spreading about Nurse Joy spending a little too much time with Norman, Max and May's father! What's going on?

title: Balance of Power
overview: Ash has challenged Max and May's father, Norman, to a battle before—but this time, it's for a Gym badge!

title: A Six Pack Attack!
overview: When Professor Oak makes a surprise appearance in Hoenn, bringing along Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle, Ash joins forces with them to battle Team Rocket.

title: The Bicker the Better
overview: When Ash and May face a duo in a double Pokémon battle, a falling out between these two friends causes them to lose--but they soon resolve their differences.

title: Grass Hysteria!
overview: When May accidentally enters a forbidden spot where only grass Pokémon live, she quickly befriends a friendly Bulbasaur.

title: Hokey Pokéballs
overview: May lets her Bulbasaur out of its Pokéball and the curious Pokémon soon gets into trouble.

title: Whiscash and Ash
overview: When a famed Whiscash swallows Ash's Gym badges, he teams up with a fisherman to try to reel it in!

title: Me, Myself and Time
overview: Ash and Pikachu meet up with an aspiring archaeologist who leads them to an ancient and mystical site.

title: A Fan with a Plan
overview: May prepares to enter her first contest open only to ribbon holders, but remains confident despite seeing the contest favorite and his powerful Masquerain.

title: Cruisin' for a Losin?
overview: May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

title: Pearls Are a Spoink's Best Friend
overview: When a Spoink loses the pearl on its head, Ash and friends volunteer to help search for it.

title: That's Just Swellow
overview: Ash, May, and Brock participate in a curious sporting event in which players use rings dangling from balloons to catch balls lying on the ground.

title: Take This House and Shuppet
overview: Fights arise both between May and Max and amongst Team Rocket, as a Shuppet--a Pokémon that feeds on human anger--stirs them to conflict.

title: A Shroomish Skirmish
overview: Team Rocket infuriates a Breloom, forcing not only themselves, but also Ash and friends to flee from its wrath.

title: Unfair-Weather Friends
overview: Ash and friends learn of Groudon and Kyogre, when Team Magma is joined by a master of disguise.

title: Who's Flying Now?
overview: Ash and friends meet up with the beautiful gym leader, Winona, at the Feather Carnival.

title: Sky High Gym Battle!
overview: It's Swellow versus Swellow as Ash and Winona battle it out in the Fortree City Gym!

title: Lights, Camerupt, Action!
overview: As the heroes continue onwards, they encounter a man pushing his Camerupt. After helping the man, the heroes are told the man, named Elijah, goes around villages and shows movies. The heroes decide to accompany them, while Team Rocket plans on stealing his equipment.

title: Crazy As a Lunatone
overview: A group of conspiracy theorists known as the Pokémon Mystery Club pursues a Lunatone suspected to be behind a recent series of strange events.

title: The Garden of Eatin'
overview: A troubled Snorlax wanders into a public park, creating no end of trouble.

title: A Scare to Remember
overview: A fierce bout of amnesia causes Pikachu to join forces with Team Rocket!

title: Pokéblock, Stock, and Berry (1)
overview: Before taking part in the Lilycove Coordinator Contest, May has time to study the art of Pokéblock preparation with a local master

title: Lessons in Lilycove (2)
overview: The Lilycove Coordinator Contest is underway but things are not looking good for May--her Combusken's Fire Spin has spiraled out of control!

title: Judgment Day!
overview: Hoping to get to Mossdeep Island, Ash and the gang are forced to take a detour.

title: Clamperl of Wisdom
overview: Our heroes reconnect with an unlucky Spoink, and it's still having trouble holding onto its pearl!

title: The Relicanth Really Can
overview: Ash and friends join a treasure hunter to explore the deep sea, but Team Rocket is right behind them!

title: The Evolutionary War
overview: When a Gorebyss-versus-Huntail rivalry develops between two islands, our heroes must get to the bottom of it!

title: Training Wrecks
overview: The residents of Muscle Island are dedicated to physical fitness-but can they keep up with Ash in a Pokémon battle?

title: Gaining Groudon (1)
overview: After a rescue at sea, our heroes find themselves aboard Team Magma's submarine and learn more about the group's plan for world domination!

title: The Scuffle of Legends (2)
overview: Team Aqua and Team Magma have awakened the ancient Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre! Can Ash and friends escape?

title: It's Still Rocket Roll to Me
overview: A Team Rocket strike on Mossdeep City drags our heroes-plus the city's twin Gym Leaders-into a space-shuttle scheme!

title: Solid As a Solrock
overview: Ash takes on the Mossdeep Gym, going up against two Gym Leaders at once!

title: Vanity Affair
overview: After winning his seventh Gym badge, Ash can't stop bragging about his battle skills...until he runs into a member of the Elite Four!

title: Where's Armaldo?
overview: In an island nature preserve, Ash and friends come face to face with several Pokémon thought to be extinct!

title: A Cacturne for the Worse
overview: May competes in a Pokémon Contest, where another Coordinator tries to sabotage her performance!

title: Claydol Big and Tall
overview: When our heroes discover an enormous Poké Ball on an island, Team Rocket's meddling unleashes an ancient destructive force!

title: Once in a Mawile
overview: Ash and friends meet a talented Trainer who performs a ribbon dance with her Mawile...until Team Rocket gets in the way!

title: Beg, Burrow and Steal
overview: To help a local researcher, our heroes explore a massive underground labyrinth created by a group of Trapinch...and get into some trouble along the way!

title: Absol-ute Disaster
overview: An Absol appears to warn a village of danger, but the villagers think it's the one causing the trouble! Can our heroes clear up this misunderstanding?

title: Let It Snow, Let It Snow, Let It Snorunt
overview: When a mischievous Snorunt steals Ash's hard-earned Gym badges, Ash chases after it-right into a raging snowstorm!

title: Do I Hear a Ralts?
overview: Max finds an injured Ralts and tries to get it to a Pokémon Center, but its friends Gardevoir and Kirlia think our heroes are trying to steal it!

title: The Great Eight Fate! (1)
overview: Ash gets ready for his final Gym battle in the Hoenn region: a Double Battle against Gym Leader Juan, who used to be a Pokémon Coordinator!

title: Eight Ain't Enough (2)
overview: Ash and Juan battle it out in the Sootopolis Gym! Can Ash win his eighth Gym badge to qualify for the Hoenn League?

title: Showdown at Linoone!
overview: When May discovers that two of her Poké Balls are missing, she naturally assumes it's Team Rocket! But the culprit could be someone else entirely...

title: Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?
overview: When Team Rocket interrupts a practice battle between May and her rival Drew, our heroes and their Pokémon have to sort out a big mix-up!

title: Date Expectations
overview: Our heroes are delayed by a herd of Donphan on their way to Pacifidlog Town! Can May make it onto the ferry in time for her final Pokémon Contest?

title: Mean with Envy (1)
overview: May enters the Pacifidlog Contest, where she goes up against rivals Joshua and Erica, plus a mysterious competitor known only as "The Jester"...

title: Pacifidlog Jam (2)
overview: May competes against an unusual Meowth in the second round of the Pacifidlog Contest. Can she win the last ribbon she needs to qualify for the Grand Festival?

title: Berry, Berry Interesting
overview: When our heroes stumble upon a wonderful berry harvest, May takes the opportunity to make some Pokéblocks for the Grand Festival, drawing the attention of a hungry Munchlax!

title: Less Is Morrison
overview: Ash meets Morrison, another Trainer who's on his way to compete in the Hoenn League, and the two immediately become fierce rivals!

title: The Ribbon Cup Caper!
overview: Aboard a luxury liner bound for Slateport City and the Grand Festival, our heroes must help Officer Jenny catch a master thief!

title: Satoshi and Haruka! Heated Battles in Hoenn!!
overview:
This is a clipshow Unaired outside of Japan of Satoshi's (Ash's) gym battles and Haruka's (May's) contest battles.

The heroes are still on the boat looking towards the Grand Festival. Ash remembers all of his Hoenn Gym Battles with Roxanne, Norman, Brawly, Juan, Tate and Lisa, while May remembers her Contests with Drew, Grace, Kelly, Harley, Erica and Savannah.

title: Hi Ho Silver Wind! (1)
overview: On the first day of the Grand Festival, May runs into her deceitful rival Harley once more!

title: Deceit and Assist (2)
overview: Ash meets a Coordinator whose ribbons have been stolen, and May listens to some bad advice before her first performance in the Grand Festival!

title: Rhapsody in Drew (3)
overview: May is up against Harley in the second round of the Grand Festival! Can she triumph over his treacherous tactics?

title: Island Time
overview: When our heroes win free tickets to Ever Grande City for the Hoenn League Championships, they're delighted-until it becomes clear this is another of Team Rocket's schemes!

title: Like a Meowth to a Flame
overview: While training for the Hoenn League, Ash meets fellow Trainer Tyson and his Meowth in boots, and they discover that the ceremonial torch has been stolen!

title: Saved by the Beldum
overview: Ash, Morrison, and Tyson register for the Hoenn League, and it appears that Tyson's Meowth has an unfortunate past...

title: From Brags to Riches
overview: In the qualifying rounds, Ash faces a serious challenge: he has to win three matches in a row, and each match is a Double Battle!

title: Shocks and Bonds (1)
overview: Ash has made it through the qualifying rounds, but now he faces an impressive Trainer named Katie in a full battle, where both of them will use all six of their Pokémon!

title: A Judgment Brawl (2)
overview: Ash has fallen behind in his full battle against Katie! Can he recover and make it to the second round?

title: Choose It or Lose It! (3)
overview: Ash faces his friend and rival Morrison in the second round of the Hoenn League!

title: At the End of the Fray (4)
overview: Ash goes up against his rival Tyson in the quarterfinals of the Hoenn League!

title: The Scheme Team
overview: The Hoenn League is over, and it's time for Ash to bid farewell to his traveling companions and head home-but he can't resist one more challenge from a Gym Leader along the way!

title: The Right Place and the Right Mime
overview: Max and May come to visit Ash in Pallet Town, along with Misty and Brock, and they all make plans for another journey together-this time, to the Battle Frontier!

title: A Real Cleffa-Hanger
overview: Our heroes stop for a picnic at the base of Mt. Moon, where they encounter the rarely seen Cleffa, Clefairy, and Clefable!

title: Numero Uno Articuno
overview: On the way to Ash's first match at the Battle Frontier, our heroes see the Legendary Pokémon Articuno flying through a snowstorm!

title: The Symbol Life
overview: Ash calls in his old friend Charizard to help in his battle against Frontier Brain Noland and his friend Articuno!

title: Hooked on Onix
overview: Provoked by Team Rocket, hordes of Rock-type Pokémon attack our heroes on their way to the Battle Arena!

title: Rough, Tough Jigglypuff
overview: Ash and friends fall into a trap set by a man who wants to catch a Jigglypuff for his daughter's birthday!

title: On Cloud Arcanine
overview: On their way to the Battle Arena, Ash and friends stop by a cake shop, but the line for it is long. They see an Arcanine come running by, and May decides to catch it. However, Drew returns and he also wants to capture it.

title: Sitting Psyduck
overview: Ash and friends rescue a sad Psyduck from a group of Fighting types, but they can't figure out how to cheer it up...

title: Hail to the Chef!
overview: Our heroes and Team Rocket check out a new restaurant owned by two sisters who can't stop squabbling!

title: Caterpie's Big Dilemma
overview: After a scientific experiment goes awry, Ash and friends try to track down a Caterpie that has grown to enormous proportions!

title: The Saffron Con
overview: Our heroes are in Saffron City for May's first Pokémon Contest in the Kanto region-and her shady rival Harley is competing, too!

title: A Hurdle for Squirtle
overview: The Saffron Pokémon Contest is under way! Can May win her first ribbon in the Kanto region?

title: Pasta La Vista!
overview: Ash checks out the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City and ends up getting recruited as a new student!

title: Fear Factor Phony
overview: Ash and friends wander into a ghost town, where they try to help settle a dispute between a group of Ghost-type Pokémon and a group of Psychic-type Pokémon.

title: Sweet Baby James
overview: When May's Munchlax gets sick, Ash and friends seek the help of a kindly couple who specialize in healing Pokémon...and who just happen to be James's Nanny and Pop-Pop!

title: A Chip Off the Old Brock
overview: After Brock's Mudkip evolves into a Marshtomp and causes some trouble, Ash and friends befriend an elderly medicine-maker and help her assistants fight off Team Rocket's thieving advances.

title: Wheel of Frontier
overview: At the Battle Arena, Ash battles Frontier Brain Greta for his second Frontier Symbol!

title: May's Egg-Cellent Adventure!
overview: May helps the daughter of a family of Pokémon Egg ranchers start her own Pokémon Contest journey, and receives her own Pokémon Egg as a thank-you gift.

title: Weekend Warrior
overview: May competes against a former rock'n'roll guitarist and band leader in the Silver Town Pokémon Contest for her second Kanto ribbon!

title: On Olden Pond
overview: Taking a break from Ash's training regimen to do a little fishing, our heroes help a young woman keep the ownership of her family's lake from a land developer.

title: Tactics Theatrics!!
overview: At the Battle Dome, Ash challenges Frontier Brain Tucker, a master of both battle tactics and showbiz savvy, for his third Frontier Symbol.

title: Reversing the Charges
overview: On their way to the Battle Pike, Ash and friends meet a supercharged Elekid who's on a rampage, attacking everything in sight--including Max!

title: The Green Guardian
overview: The Mythical Pokémon Celebi has been injured in the forest, and Ash and friends, along with a Pokémon Ranger, nurse Celebi back to health.

title: From Cradle to Save
overview: On their way to the Battle Pike, our heroes come across a Pokémon ninja school, where they help the students rescue their Pokémon from Team Rocket's clutches.

title: Time Warp Heals All Wounds
overview: At an abandoned train station, May meets a woman who lost the love of her life thanks to a sad twist of fate.

title: Queen of the Serpentine!
overview: At the Battle Pike, Ash must further hone his on-the-spot strategy skills to defeat a soft-spoken, fierce Frontier Brain named Queen Lucy and win his fourth Frontier Symbol.

title: Off the Unbeaten Path
overview: After arriving on Potpourri Island, our heroes discover the Pokémon Orienteering competition just about to take place and decide to enter, vying for the coveted Pokémon Teamwork medal!

title: Harley Rides Again
overview: In the Wisteria Town Pokémon Contest, May discovers she is to compete against her old rival Harley.

title: Odd Pokémon Out!
overview: As our heroes continue toward May's next Pokémon Contest, Ash's Grovyle finds itself nursing a crush on Nurse Joy's Meganium!

title: Spontaneous Combusken!
overview: After meeting a new Coordinator named Brianna who's a fan of hers and an even bigger fan of Drew's, May discovers she must battle her in order to win her third Pokémon Contest ribbon.

title: Cutting the Ties that Bind!
overview: After a frustrated Sceptile runs off into the forest, Ash and Pikachu go after it and run into a swarm of angry Beedrill--and the next Frontier Brain!

title: Ka Boom with a View!
overview: It's time for Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge: a battle in the impressive outdoor arena at the Battle Palace, against Frontier Brain Spenser!

title: King and Queen for a Day!
overview: On their way to Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge, our heroes come across a couple of Pokémon TV stars who aren't feeling well, so Brock's Bonsly and James's Mime Jr. act as stand-ins!

title: Curbing the Crimson Tide!
overview: After hearing stories about many Trainers and Pokémon being defeated and taunted by a mysterious talking Pokémon known as Red Lightning, our heroes decide to find out what's really going on.

title: What I Did for Love!
overview: When Brock meets up with a lovely Pokémon breeder who used to be a Coordinator, she talks him into competing against May in the Gardenia Pokémon Contest!

title: Three Jynx and a Baby!
overview: On their way to the Battle Tower for Ash's next challenge, our heroes come across a cute little Smoochum who is fiercely guarded by three Jynx, and Ash has to convince them he's on their side!

title: Talking a Good Game!
overview: On their way to the Battle Tower, our heroes meet an amazing person who seems to be able to communicate with Pokémon by sensing their feelings...and more surprises await!

title: Second Time's the Charm!
overview: After losing to Frontier Brain Anabel, Ash buckles down for some unusual special training--and Anabel joins him! Can he defeat her in the rematch?

title: Pokémon Ranger! Deoxys' Crisis!
overview: After witnessing strange behavior from several kinds of Pokémon on their way to Pewter City, our heroes and Pokémon Ranger Solana encounter an electromagnetic disturbance, which leads them to the discovery of a troubled Deoxys!

title: All That Glitters Is Not Golden!
overview: On their way to Ash's final Frontier Battle and Brock's hometown of Pewter City, our heroes discover a wandering golden Sudowoodo and the estranged Trainer who caused its unusual coloring.

title: New Plot, Odd Lot!
overview: May is going after her fifth Contest Ribbon to qualify for the Grand Festival, but when her shady rival Harley teams up with Team Rocket, things don't look good!

title: Going for Choke!
overview: After a shaky start in the Mulberry Pokémon Contest, May makes it through to the finals, where she goes up against "Jessebella"--Team Rocket's Jessie in disguise!

title: The Ole' Berate and Switch!
overview: After a squabble causes Jessie and James to part ways, they team up with fellow Team Rocket agents Butch and Cassidy for a Poké Ball-swiping scheme!

title: Grating Spaces!
overview: Upon arriving in Pewter City, our heroes learn that Brock's old Gym is being remodeled by none other than Team Rocket in disguise, and Brock and Ash must battle them to put a stop to it!

title: Battling the Enemy Within!
overview: In the ancient ruins beneath the Battle Pyramid, Ash is mysteriously possessed by the spirit of an ancient and evil king, who challenges Frontier Brain Brandon to a battle for all of his Pokémon.

title: Slaking Kong!
overview: On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes help a berry farmer reclaim his stolen crop.

title: May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!
overview: As the Grand Festival gets under way at the Indigo Plateau, May has her hands full trying to compete with the best Coordinators in the world, including Harley, Drew, and new friend Solidad!

title: Thinning the Hoard!
overview: The Grand Festival is going strong as May faces down one impressive competitor after another!

title: Channeling the Battle Zone!
overview: May faces Drew in the quarterfinals of the Grand Festival, and the two seem to be very evenly matched! Can May come out ahead?

title: Aipom and Circumstance!
overview: On their way to Ash's rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid in Fennel Valley, our heroes come across a village taking part in the annual ritual of choosing a king, and Ash's Aipom becomes a most unwilling candidate!

title: Strategy Tomorrow - Comedy Tonight!
overview: Our heroes meet an aspiring comedian named Audrey and her showbiz sidekick and Pokémon partner, Chatot.

title: Duels of the Jungle!
overview: Our heroes find themselves embroiled in Pokémon politics as two Weavile face off for leadership of a group of Sneasel!

title: Overjoyed!
overview: When our heroes arrive at the Battle Pyramid for Ash's battle with Brandon, they discover a Nurse Joy who's a big fan of Ash and May!

title: The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!
overview: After their recent defeats in important matches at the Battle Pyramid and the Grand Festival, Ash and May are feeling a little down, until several old friends come together to support them.

title: Pinch Healing!
overview: When Nurse Joy becomes too ill to take care of the Pokémon Center, our heroes pitch in, coming to the aid of a Pokésitter and his charges after a bus accident.

title: Gathering the Gang of Four!
overview: Ash prepares for his final rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid by rounding up the Pokémon he's been with the longest, spending his time sharing old memories with them and training intensely.

title: Pace - The Final Frontier!
overview: Ash has lost to Brandon in two previous battles, and now his Charizard has been defeated! Can he battle back to claim the final Frontier Symbol?

title: Once More with Reeling! (1)
overview: Ash has beaten the Battle Frontier, but his competitive spirit won't let him rest for long, and he and May both sign up for an unofficial Pokémon Contest in Terracotta Town!

title: Home Is Where the Start Is! (2)
overview: After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!
